title: Restoring guardrails.
officialText:
The guardrail system shall be reinstalled immediately following the end of active loading
or unloading operations, or active work, or at the end of the workday, whichever occurs sooner.
Exception: Where material overhangs overnight in accordance with Section 3303.4.5.2.
